rubric.role_summary: Investment associate helping build a San Francisco compute investing practice by sourcing opportunities, conducting diligence, developing investment theses, and supporting portfolio companies across compute hardware and software.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Investment associate helping build a San Francisco compute investing practice by sourcing opportunities, conducting diligence, developing investment theses, and supporting portfolio companies across compute hardware and software.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 2+ years of experience, including at least 1+ years in a production engineering role at a leading tech company, AI lab, or high-growth startup.
- Computer Science degree or equivalent experience.
- Experience working inside startups.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
